stem.text: Sodium burns in oxygen giving out heat energy and forming the compound $\text{Na}_2\text{O}$. The equation for this reaction is shown.
Which statement about the reaction is correct?

A.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}$ for the reaction is equal to twice the bond energy of the Na–O bond.

B.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}$ for the reaction is positive.

C.text: The equation represents the standard enthalpy change of combustion of sodium.

D.text: The equation represents the standard enthalpy change of formation of sodium oxide.
